name: ServerSearch
description: Adds a search button to the server list that finds your servers as you type and jumps straight to them.
author: Pharaoh2k
features: Search button pinned below the server list
Filters your servers as you type, best matches first
Ignores case, accents and styled letters
Finds servers by the initials shown on servers without an icon
Shows each server's folder and finds servers by folder name
Shows mention counts and unread dots
Keyboard controls: arrow keys, Enter and Esc
Automatic update checking with changelog display
